query: As a working parent of a 10-year-old trying to balance career and family, help me understand the real impact of both passive screen time (like TV and YouTube) and interactive screen time (like educational apps, games, and tablets) on children of similar age. I want to know (1) how much screen time is actually harmful and what types of content or activities matter most at this age, (2) whether educational apps and online learning are genuinely helping my child learn or just keeping them busy, (3) how screen time affects children's sleep, behavior, and social skills in ways I can actually observe, and (4) what realistic strategies work for busy families to manage screen time with children without constant battles. Give me practical guidance based on recent research, not just general recommendations that don't fit real family life.
